name: Paper Craft
summary:
Paper Craft is a made for VR 3D platformer.

Demo out now!

With up to 5 unique powerups that change the game in different ways, your adventure will test your platforming skills.

A campaign made of 20 levels that were all made using the in-game level editor. Each level designed to use your skills that have been learned so far to continue further to the end.

The game also comes with the very level editor that we used to make the campaign. The level editor is designed to be as user friendly as possible and
